 Purito Seoul Offers Up to 72% Off Bestselling K-Beauty Skincare for Black Friday
 Oleh PR NEWSWIRE 
 19 November 2026, 1:30 pm 
 Share on facebook

 Share on linkedin 
 The Amazon Black Friday and Cyber Monday event runs Nov. 19–30, featuring up to 40% off the Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream and up to 44% off the Retinol Retinal 2000 NAD+ Serum, plus additional bundle savings. 
 NEW YORK , Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Korean skincare brand Purito Seoul is bringing welcome news to shoppers struggling with winter skin concerns. Through Nov. 30, Purito Seoul is taking part in Amazon’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday event, with discounts of up to 72% off list price. Shoppers can find the Amazon bestseller Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream at up to 40% off and the Retinol Retinal 2000 NAD+ Serum at up to 44% off.
 The spotlight of this promotion is on Purito Seoul’s four hero products. Built around specific skin concerns, the hero lineup is organized into four layers: Barrier Repair, Blemish Calm, Age-Defying and UV Defense. The hero products are also available at up to 48.9% off list price during the event. Among them, the Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream, which has built buzz on TikTok, was named a Rookie in the Global Trend category at the 2025 Olive Young Awards, hosted by Olive Young, Korea’s largest beauty retailer.
 Purito Seoul offers up to 72% off during Amazon’s Black Friday event through Nov. 30. 
 What Benefits Does Panthenol Offer the Skin Barrier? 
 Also known as provitamin B5, panthenol is a well-known moisturizing ingredient that attracts and holds water in the skin. Once absorbed, it converts into vitamin B5, which is known to help produce the lipids that make up the skin barrier. Purito Seoul’s Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream contains a high 10% concentration of panthenol to deliver both hydration and barrier care. As cold winds leave the skin barrier especially vulnerable at year’s end, adding Purito Seoul’s panthenol cream to a daily skincare routine can help keep dry, sensitive skin comfortably hydrated.
 Why Pair Retinol With Retinal ? 
 Retinol is one of the best-known ingredients for firmness. Purito Seoul’s Retinol Retinal 2000 NAD+ Serum combines two retinoids in a single formula: retinol, which supports firmer-looking skin over time, and retinal, which helps quickly smooth the look of skin texture, each at 0.1%. NAD+, which helps bring radiance to the skin, rounds out the formula to support a nighttime skincare routine.
 "At Purito Seoul, we believe that sensitive skin deserves effective skincare that delivers visible results," said a Purito Seoul spokesperson. "This Black Friday is a great opportunity for our consumers to discover our bestselling products and build a skincare routine tailored to their individual skin concerns at exceptional value."
 Meet Purito Seoul’s Four Hero Products 
 Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream 
A deeply moisturizing barrier cream formulated with 10% panthenol. Bamboo grown in Damyang, Korea, helps replenish and fortify the moisture barrier of dry, sensitive skin, while niacinamide and squalane add a healthy-looking glow. It earned a 5-Star rating, the highest score, in skin compatibility testing by Dermatest, a German dermatological testing institute, making it gentle enough for sensitive skin.
 Retinol Retinal 2000 NAD+ Serum 
A dual-retinoid night serum with 0.1% each of retinol and retinal. Its bi-phase formula activates with a quick shake before use, and its non-sticky, watery texture layers seamlessly with other products. It has completed hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic and sensitive-skin irritation testing. Suitable for both retinoid beginners and experienced users, it helps improve the look of skin texture and firmness.
 Oat In Calming Gel Cream 
A soothing, hydrating gel cream made with 77% oat seed water from oats grown in Gunsan, Korea. Its bouncy gel texture melts into the skin, leaving stressed skin feeling fresh, calm and comfortable. Having completed non-comedogenic testing, it is gentle enough for acne-prone skin and holds a 5-Star rating from Dermatest.
 Sun Day Adventure Sunscreen SPF 50 
Soft, yet strong. Its smooth, milky texture glides on easily and sets to a soft, comfortable finish with no white cast. Broad Spectrum SPF 50 provides everyday protection from UVA and UVB rays, with a lightweight, breathable feel that stays comfortable throughout the day. Having completed hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic and sensitive-skin irritation testing, it is gentle enough for sensitive skin to wear every day.
 Black Friday: A Chance to Complete Your Skincare Routine 
 The more you add, the more you save. During the event, Purito Seoul is also offering a tiered bundle deal on Amazon: an extra 15% off when shoppers buy two featured products, 20% off three, and 25% off four or more.
 About Purito Seoul 
 Founded in 2017, Purito Seoul was built on a simple belief: "Sensitive Skin Wants Results, Too." The brand’s strength lies in formulas designed to remove unnecessary burden from the skin, focusing on a complete skincare routine built with only the essentials. That belief runs through every product as the brand’s "From Soil to Seoul" philosophy: ingredients grown in Korean soil build the skin’s foundation (Soil), and refined formulas designed for modern skin concerns deliver the answers (Seoul).
 Purito Seoul is rapidly expanding its presence in the U.S. through major online and offline retail channels. Online, its products are available through Amazon.com , YesStyle , Target and Bloomingdale’s , a leading U.S. department store chain. Offline, the brand is reaching more local shoppers through Olive Young U.S.’s Pasadena store. In September, Purito Seoul launched in 611 Target Beauty Studio locations nationwide, significantly expanding its brick-and-mortar footprint. The move makes its products more accessible to U.S. consumers while accelerating brand awareness. Follow Purito Seoul on Instagram and TikTok for the latest news.
